method: abstract structural families from all 11 false deterministics; fixture IDs recorded for provenance only, never used as rule concepts

families.mechanism: quote/attribution spans coexist with out-of-quote commitment signals (disagreement clause, hypothetical framing) or cover the entire output; endorsement cannot be adjudicated mechanically
families.adjudication: B for OFF-SCOPE-01/OFF-SCOPE-02 (quote + competing out-of-quote commitment signal -> ABSTAIN); C for OFF-SCOPE-08 and OFF-SCOPE-16 (gold disputes: QUOTED_ONLY vs ABSTAIN is a contract boundary, no engine rule)

families.mechanism: route proposition and operator exist only inside parentheses; commitment scope is non-standard and cannot borrow licensing through the parenthetical boundary
families.adjudication: B (route noun/operators only inside parentheses -> ABSTAIN)

families.mechanism: one route candidate receives competing polarity labels from different clauses (assertion + negated hedge qualifier; negation clause + hypothetical clause); existing mixed guard requires 2+ candidates so single-candidate conflicts collapse to highest priority
families.adjudication: B (single candidate with 2+ distinct polar labels from {ASSERTED, NEGATED, HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY} and no retraction resolution -> ABSTAIN; retraction keeps resolving to SELF_RETRACTED per burned VR-R/CMT-R binding)

families.mechanism: negation scoped inside conditional antecedent (dersom ... ikke ...) fires NEGATED over a route that only appears in the consequent; polarity of the antecedent is not polarity of the route proposition
families.adjudication: A (deterministic: NEGATED does not fire from a negation preceded by a conditional marker in the same clause; HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY stands)

families.mechanism: two hedged clauses each carrying a different route candidate present alternative framing; operator-to-target pairing is not uniquely determinable
families.adjudication: B (2+ candidates with hedge markers bound to different candidates -> ABSTAIN; also covers MULTIPLE_ROUTE_CANDIDATES_AMBIGUOUS for hedged alternation)

families.mechanism: already deterministically guarded in V1.6A.2 (BC_ROUTE_AMBIGUOUS_02 same-clause competition; BC_ROUTE_MIXED_POLARITY_03 multi-candidate polarity); no fresh official failure landed here without also being hedge competition
families.adjudication: existing guards confirmed; no new rule needed

families.mechanism: non-endorsement construction (kan ikke staa inne for) without a prior assertion to retract; whether this is NEGATED or SELF_RETRACTED is a contract boundary, not a mechanical defect
families.adjudication: C (gold dispute; no engine rule in this task)

families.mechanism: assertion followed by trailing conditional qualifier (dersom ...); whether trailing condition demotes ASSERTED to HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY is a contract boundary
families.adjudication: C (gold dispute; no engine rule in this task)
